note: The L12 known-exposure ratchet carries only individually reviewed findings about an already published historical Core coordinate. Public evidence: https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-noa-scitt-ai-agent-receipt-00.txt Appendix A. Content findings bind to exact unit bytes; path findings use the domain-separated exact canonical path hash. This is not a repository-visibility assertion or an exemption for new content. Every entry requires why, remediation, and reviewedAt; malformed entries are refused.
keyFormat: sha256(unit content):ruleId OR sha256(noa-boundary:path:v1\0 + canonical repository-relative path):ruleId
